items.title: Stella Oliver Interview, 1959-04-22
items.q: We lived with her about three years in New York.

ctx.x: But the one in New York is still living?
Is still living, yes. Is that Mrs. Johnson? Mrs. Johnson, that's Mrs. Johnson, who he loved dearly. We lived with her about three years in New York.

Oh, excuse me for interrupting. Is that chair comfortable? I put the microphone on this side. Would you rather... Mrs. No, this is chair comfortable. Because I thought maybe you wanted to lean against the back more. Mrs. No, this is... Yes. Is that all right? Because we could put the microphone on the other side. Mrs. And then...
